label: The Tumbledown Isles
summary: A cluster of small, friendly islands linked by ferry turtles, where you have just inherited a run-down potion shop.

world.era: A long, gentle age of small magic
world.setting: The Tumbledown Isles, five islands linked by ferry turtles and rope bridges
world.description: On the Tumbledown Isles, magic is mostly small: charms against damp, potions for heartache, lanterns that glow when someone is thinking of you. Everybody knows everybody, the ferry turtles keep their own timetable, and the Harvest Lantern festival is the most important night of the year.
rules: Nothing truly terrible happens here; problems are small, warm and funny
Neighbors notice everything and help anyway
Seasons change, crops grow and festivals come around
Magic is everyday and a little unreliable
